topic: market signal review and strategy implications
hypothesis: skills.sh install counters are per-listing cached samples of a single per-bundle demand unit: mirrors of one bundle post near-identical hourly increments (~1.1-1.7k/hr) while their lifetime levels differ ~2.3x purely from listing age, so bundle demand must be read as the max/envelope across listings and never as a sum (repo install sums overstate by 4.9x-53x; 62.3% of listings were frozen inside a 59-minute window, biasing single-snapshot reads downward and toward freshly-cached pages). Competitors must therefore be ranked on install flow at bundle level, with lifetime treated as maturity rather than size.
method: delta-level test of cycle 72's E73 falsification criterion on two cached crawls 59 minutes apart; read-only, no external actions

inflation.clustering_rule: cosine>=0.999 and per-window ratio CV<=2% over >=6 positive windows

flow.note: floor: frozen mirrors contribute zero and are excluded
flow.level_vs_flow_disagreement: find-skills holds the largest lifetime (4.01M, 4.4x the next) but ranks 6th in current demand; mattpocock/skills contributed the largest repo delta (6096 over 18 movers) as one bundle spread over 36 listings

rules: Bundle demand = max/envelope across the bundle's listings. Never sum installs across skills of a repo or across mirrors.
Rank competitors on install flow (installs/hour, bundle level); lifetime is maturity/listing age and must not be read as competitor size or compared across mirrors.
Publish the frozen-listing share with every snapshot; a zero delta is a stale page, not zero demand.
A mirror is a channel; repo and mirror counts measure distribution breadth, never rivalry breadth.
Cycle 72's mirror-independence falsification test is withdrawn: it compared listing-level counters, where stale cache reads masquerade as independent counters.
next_experiment: E74: 24h-apart listing-granularity crawl of the superpowers mirrors plus a mid-day crawl - confirm mirror rate equality over long windows, measure page-cache TTL so the frozen share becomes a model, and rebuild the full-corpus head board on flow at bundle level. Falsification: mirror rate divergence > 2x over multi-hour windows, sibling listings inside one repo showing different increments in the same minute, mirror level gaps narrowing rather than widening over 24h, or re-read frozen listings returning zero forever.
external_actions: none (read-only analysis of cached crawl artifacts; one analyze proposal created)
